nodes.name: Normalize
nodes.notes: Booking rules live in CFG at the top. Validates input per action.

nodes.name: Respond Result
nodes.notes: Shared response for every branch that answers immediately.

additionalFields.description: ={{ [$('Normalize').first().json.cfg.tag + ' (voice agent booking)', 'Status: pending approval', '', 'Name: ' + $('Normalize').first().json.name, 'Email: ' + $('Normalize').first().json.email, 'Phone: ' + ($('Normalize').first().json.phone || 'not given'), 'Topic: ' + ($('Normalize').first().json.topic || 'not given')].join('\n') }}

nodes.name: Create Hold
nodes.notes: Tentative hold: blocks the slot, Meet link attached, no attendees yet so no invite goes out.

nodes.name: Respond Book Pending
nodes.notes: Answer the voice agent now, then wait for approval in the background.

nodes.name: Confirm Booking
nodes.notes: Adds the caller as attendee and sends the invite (Meet link already on the event).

parameters.text: =✅ Confirmed: {{ $('Normalize').first().json.safe.name }} on {{ $('Check Slot').first().json.when }} ET. Invite with Meet link sent to {{ $('Normalize').first().json.safe.email }}.

=❌ Declined: hold removed for {{ $('Normalize').first().json.safe.name }} ({{ $('Check Slot').first().json.when }} ET). They were told you'd confirm, so follow up at {{ $('Normalize').first().json.safe.email }} / {{ $('Normalize').first().json.safe.phone }}.
=✅ Moved to {{ $('Check Reschedule').first().json.new_when }} ET. Updated invite sent.
=❌ Reschedule declined. The call stays at {{ $('Check Reschedule').first().json.old_when }} ET. The caller wasn't notified, so follow up at {{ $('Normalize').first().json.safe.email }}.
=✅ Cancelled the call on {{ $('Check Cancel').first().json.when }} ET. Caller notified.
=❌ Kept the call on {{ $('Check Cancel').first().json.when }} ET. The caller wasn't notified, so follow up at {{ $('Normalize').first().json.safe.email }}.
